en: Let's keep it warm!
zh: 讓我們保持溫暖！
ja: 暖かくしていましょう！
local: Let's keep it warm!
ja_pron: Atatakaku shite imashou!
native: Let's keep it warm!

en: You totally should retract!
zh: 你完全應該收回！
ja: 絶対に撤回すべきです！
local: You totally should retract!
ja_pron: Zettai ni tekkai subeki desu!
native: You totally should retract!

en: I know the
zh: 我知道
ja: 私は知っています
local: I know the
ja_pron: Watashi wa shitteimasu
native: I know the

en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然界中變化的模式
ja: 2000年以上前、古代中国の学者たちは自然界の変化するパターンを観察しました
local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
ja_pron: Nisen nen ijou mae, kodai Chūgoku no gakusha-tachi wa shizen-kai no henka suru pataan o kansatsu shimashita
native: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural

en: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
zh: 世界、氣候、季節的變換和天文學。
ja: 世界、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学です。
local: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
ja_pron: Sekai, kikō, kisetsu no utsurikawari, soshite tenmongaku desu.
native: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

en: This scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating
zh: 這些學者測量並將太陽的年度運動分成24條路徑，創造了
ja: これらの学者は太陽の年間の動きを測定し、24の区分に分けて作り出しました
local: This scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating
ja_pron: Korera no gakusha wa taiyō no nenkan no ugoki o sokutei shi, 24 no kubun ni wakete tsukuridashimashita
native: This scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating

en: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
zh: 24節氣，這些節氣用於管理古代中國的農業。
ja: 24節気で、これは古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
local: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
ja_pron: 24 sekki de, kore wa kodai Chūgoku no nōgyō o kanri suru tame ni tsukaware mashita.
native: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

en: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions
zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍指導著數億人的生活和傳統
ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は数億人の生活と伝統を導いています。
local: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions
ja_pron: Kyou ni itaru made, kono hatsumei wa suu oku nin no seikatsu to dentou o michibiiteimasu.
native: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions

en: of Chinese people.
zh: 中國人民。
ja: 中国の人々の生活です。
local: of Chinese people.
ja_pron: Chūgoku no hitobito no seikatsu desu.
native: of Chinese people.

en: Every year, around November 22, the light snow solar term comes.
zh: 每年約在11月22日，輕雪節氣到來。
ja: 毎年11月22日頃、軽い雪の節気が訪れます。
local: Every year, around November 22, the light snow solar term comes.
ja_pron: Mainen 11 gatsu 22 nichi goro, karui yuki no sekki ga otozuremasu.
native: Every year, around November 22, the light snow solar term comes.

en: Chinese farmers light snow.
zh: 中國農民輕雪。
ja: 中国の農民は軽い雪を迎えます。
local: Chinese farmers light snow.
ja_pron: Chūgoku no nōmin wa karui yuki o mukaemasu.
native: Chinese farmers light snow.

en: Snow during the light snow season means a good harvest and abundant production in the following
zh: 輕雪季節的雪象徵著來年豐收和豐富的產量
ja: 軽い雪の季節の雪は、翌年の豊作と豊かな生産を意味します。
local: Snow during the light snow season means a good harvest and abundant production in the following
ja_pron: Karui yuki no kisetsu no yuki wa, yokunen no hōsaku to yutaka na seisan o imi shimasu.
native: Snow during the light snow season means a good harvest and abundant production in the following

en: year.
zh: 年。
ja: 年です。
local: year.
ja_pron: Toshi desu.
native: year.

en: In this snow is the crystallization of a thousand years of experience.
zh: 這雪中結晶著千年的經驗。
ja: この雪には千年の経験の結晶があります。
local: In this snow is the crystallization of a thousand years of experience.
ja_pron: Kono yuki ni wa sennen no keiken no kesshō ga arimasu.
native: In this snow is the crystallization of a thousand years of experience.

en: The light snow solar term has arrived, northern China may have been frozen solid for
zh: 輕雪節氣已到，華北可能已經結冰一段時間了
ja: 軽い雪の節気が到来し、北中国はしばらく凍結しているかもしれません。
local: The light snow solar term has arrived, northern China may have been frozen solid for
ja_pron: Karui yuki no sekki ga tōrai shi, kita Chūgoku wa shibaraku tōketsu shite iru kamo shiremasen.
native: The light snow solar term has arrived, northern China may have been frozen solid for

en: a while now.
zh: 一段時間了。
ja: しばらくの間です。
local: a while now.
ja_pron: Shibaraku no aida desu.
native: a while now.

en: But right down at the southern edge of China, the rice has only just been harvested.
zh: 但在中國南部邊緣，稻米剛剛收割。
ja: しかし、中国の南端では、稲がちょうど収穫されたばかりです。
local: But right down at the southern edge of China, the rice has only just been harvested.
ja_pron: Shikashi, Chūgoku no nantan de wa, ine ga chōdo shūkaku sareta bakari desu.
native: But right down at the southern edge of China, the rice has only just been harvested.

en: For one of China's oldest ethnic groups, known as the Miao, this is when they get to celebrate
zh: 對於中國最古老的民族之一，苗族，這是他們慶祝的時候
ja: 中国で最も古い民族の一つである苗族にとって、これは彼らが祝う時です。
local: For one of China's oldest ethnic groups, known as the Miao, this is when they get to celebrate
ja_pron: Chūgoku de mottomo furui minzoku no hitotsu de aru Byōzoku ni totte, kore wa karera ga iwau toki desu.
native: For one of China's oldest ethnic groups, known as the Miao, this is when they get to celebrate

en: New Year.
zh: 新年。
ja: 新年です。
local: New Year.
ja_pron: Shinnen desu.
native: New Year.

en: It's the light snow season for some, but it's party time for the Miao.
zh: 對某些人來說是輕雪季節，但對苗族來說是派對時間。
ja: 一部の人にとっては軽い雪の季節ですが、苗族にとってはパーティーの時間です。
local: It's the light snow season for some, but it's party time for the Miao.
ja_pron: Ichibu no hito ni totte wa karui yuki no kisetsu desu ga, Byōzoku ni totte wa pātī no jikan desu.
native: It's the light snow season for some, but it's party time for the Miao.

en: 56 state recognized ethnic groups live in China.
zh: 中國有56個國家認可的民族。
ja: 中国には56の国家認定の民族が住んでいます。
local: 56 state recognized ethnic groups live in China.
ja_pron: Chūgoku ni wa 56 no kokka nintei no minzoku ga sundeimasu.
native: 56 state recognized ethnic groups live in China.

en: Each group has its own unique traditions.
zh: 每個族群都有自己獨特的傳統。
ja: それぞれのグループには独自の伝統があります。
local: Each group has its own unique traditions.
ja_pron: Sorezore no gurūpu ni wa dokuji no dentō ga arimasu.
native: Each group has its own unique traditions.

en: The Miao are the fourth largest group by population.
zh: 苗族是人口第四大的族群。
ja: 苗族は人口で4番目に大きなグループです。
local: The Miao are the fourth largest group by population.
ja_pron: Byōzoku wa jinkō de yonbanme ni ōkina gurūpu desu.
native: The Miao are the fourth largest group by population.

en: They have their own language, but it's never been written down.
zh: 他們有自己的語言，但從未被書寫下來。
ja: 彼らには独自の言語がありますが、書き記されたことはありません。
local: They have their own language, but it's never been written down.
ja_pron: Karera ni wa dokuji no gengo ga arimasu ga, kaki shirusareta koto wa arimasen.
native: They have their own language, but it's never been written down.

en: The survival of their customs relies on stories past generation to generation at times
zh: 他們習俗的延續依賴於代代相傳的故事，有時候
ja: 彼らの習慣の存続は、時には世代から世代へと伝えられる物語に依存しています。
local: The survival of their customs relies on stories past generation to generation at times
ja_pron: Karera no shūkan no sonzoku wa, toki ni wa sedai kara sedai e to tsutaerareru monogatari ni izon shiteimasu.
native: The survival of their customs relies on stories past generation to generation at times

en: like this.
zh: 像這樣。
ja: このように。
local: like this.
ja_pron: Kono yō ni.
native: like this.

en: This Miao village's rice crop has just been brought in.
zh: 這個苗族村莊的稻米剛剛收割完。
ja: この苗族の村の稲作はちょうど収穫されたところです。
local: This Miao village's rice crop has just been brought in.
ja_pron: Kono Byōzoku no mura no inasaku wa chōdo shūkaku sareta tokoro desu.
native: This Miao village's rice crop has just been brought in.

en: There's no one left hanging about in the fields.
zh: 田裡沒有人逗留。
ja: 畑に誰も残っていません。
local: There's no one left hanging about in the fields.
ja_pron: Hatake ni dare mo nokotte imasen.
native: There's no one left hanging about in the fields.

en: People are getting ready for the best moment of the year, when they can all go out and
zh: 人們正在準備一年中最美好的時刻，大家可以一起外出
ja: 人々は一年で最も素晴らしい瞬間の準備をしています。みんなで外に出かけられる時です。
local: People are getting ready for the best moment of the year, when they can all go out and
ja_pron: Hitobito wa ichinen de mottomo subarashii shunkan no junbi o shiteimasu. Minna de soto ni dekakerareru toki desu.
native: People are getting ready for the best moment of the year, when they can all go out and

en: celebrate the year's harvest.
zh: 慶祝一年的豐收。
ja: その年の収穫を祝います。
local: celebrate the year's harvest.
ja_pron: Sono toshi no shūkaku o iwaimasu.
native: celebrate the year's harvest.

en: This young village of Xiaofu fishes in the fields recently vacated by the rice.
zh: 這個年輕的曉福村在剛收割的稻田裡捕魚。
ja: この若い曉福村は、最近稲が収穫された田んぼで魚を釣っています。
local: This young village of Xiaofu fishes in the fields recently vacated by the rice.
ja_pron: Kono wakai Xiaofu mura wa, saikin ine ga shūkaku sareta tanbo de sakana o tsutteimasu.
native: This young village of Xiaofu fishes in the fields recently vacated by the rice.

en: He's fishing for a kind of carp that has lived in the rice paddies since ancient times.
zh: 他正在捕一種自古以來就生活在稻田裡的鯉魚。
ja: 彼は古くから田んぼに生息している鯉の一種を釣っています。
local: He's fishing for a kind of carp that has lived in the rice paddies since ancient times.
ja_pron: Kare wa furuku kara tanbo ni seisoku shite iru koi no isshu o tsutteimasu.
native: He's fishing for a kind of carp that has lived in the rice paddies since ancient times.

en: The field fish, as it is known here, looks stunning, with bright colours, and it tastes
zh: 這裡稱為田魚的魚看起來很漂亮，色彩鮮豔，味道
ja: ここで田魚と呼ばれる魚は鮮やかな色彩で美しく、味も良いです。
local: The field fish, as it is known here, looks stunning, with bright colours, and it tastes
ja_pron: Koko de tengyo to yobareru sakana wa azayaka na shikisai de utsukushiku, aji mo yoi desu.
native: The field fish, as it is known here, looks stunning, with bright colours, and it tastes

en: delicious, even scales are soft enough to be eaten.
zh: 美味，甚至魚鱗都軟到可以吃。
ja: 美味しく、鱗さえも柔らかくて食べられます。
local: delicious, even scales are soft enough to be eaten.
ja_pron: Oishiku, uroko sae mo yawarakakute taberaremasu.
native: delicious, even scales are soft enough to be eaten.

en: It may be much warmer than in the north, but the water temperature is still pretty chilly
zh: 這裡可能比北方暖和得多，但水溫仍然相當冷
ja: 北よりはずっと暖かいかもしれませんが、水温はまだかなり冷たいです。
local: It may be much warmer than in the north, but the water temperature is still pretty chilly
ja_pron: Kita yori wa zutto atatakai kamoshiremasen ga, suion wa mada kanari tsumetai desu.
native: It may be much warmer than in the north, but the water temperature is still pretty chilly

en: at around five degrees Celsius.
zh: 大約攝氏五度。
ja: 約摂氏5度です。
local: at around five degrees Celsius.
ja_pron: Yaku sesshi 5-do desu.
native: at around five degrees Celsius.

en: China was the first country in the world to breed fresh waterfish.
zh: 中國是世界上第一個養殖淡水魚的國家。
ja: 中国は世界で最初に淡水魚を養殖した国です。
local: China was the first country in the world to breed fresh waterfish.
ja_pron: Chūgoku wa sekai de saisho ni tansui-gyo o yōshoku shita kuni desu.
native: China was the first country in the world to breed fresh waterfish.

en: As early as 3,000 years ago, the Chinese began raising fish and ponds.
zh: 早在三千年前，中國人就開始在池塘養魚。
ja: 3000年前には、中国人は池で魚を育て始めました。
local: As early as 3,000 years ago, the Chinese began raising fish and ponds.
ja_pron: 3000 nen mae ni wa, Chūgokujin wa ike de sakana o sodate hajimemashita.
native: As early as 3,000 years ago, the Chinese began raising fish and ponds.

en: Using the rice fields to keep them captive, these fish have kept pests and weeds to
zh: 利用稻田來圈養牠們，這些魚已經控制了害蟲和雜草
ja: 稲田を使って魚を飼い、害虫や雑草を抑えてきました。
local: Using the rice fields to keep them captive, these fish have kept pests and weeds to
ja_pron: Inada o tsukatte sakana o kai, gaichū ya zassō o osaete kimashita.
native: Using the rice fields to keep them captive, these fish have kept pests and weeds to

en: a minimum for 2,000 years.
zh: 兩千年來保持在最低限度。
ja: 2000年間、最小限に抑えています。
local: a minimum for 2,000 years.
ja_pron: 2000 nenkan, saishōgen ni osaeteimasu.
native: a minimum for 2,000 years.

en: Caminior has enriched the soil too.
zh: 魚糞也使土壤肥沃。
ja: 魚の排泄物は土壌も豊かにします。
local: Caminior has enriched the soil too.
ja_pron: Sakana no haisetsubutsu wa dojo mo yutakani shimasu.
native: Caminior has enriched the soil too.

en: This is how to max out your rice fields.
zh: 這就是如何最大化你的稻田。
ja: これが稲田を最大限に活用する方法です。
local: This is how to max out your rice fields.
ja_pron: Kore ga inada o saidaigen ni katsuyō suru hōhō desu.
native: This is how to max out your rice fields.

en: Plus, you get to eat the fish after.
zh: 而且，之後你還可以吃魚。
ja: さらに、その後に魚を食べることができます。
local: Plus, you get to eat the fish after.
ja_pron: Sarani, sono ato ni sakana o taberu koto ga dekimasu.
native: Plus, you get to eat the fish after.

en: Xiaofu has just caught himself a tasty New Year's Eve dinner.
zh: 曉福剛剛捕到了一頓美味的除夕晚餐。
ja: 曉福はちょうど美味しい大晦日の夕食を捕まえました。
local: Xiaofu has just caught himself a tasty New Year's Eve dinner.
ja_pron: Xiaofu wa chōdo oishii ōmisoka no yūshoku o tsukamaemashita.
native: Xiaofu has just caught himself a tasty New Year's Eve dinner.

en: While Xiaofu fishes out in the paddies, his mother gets preparing to hit the town.
zh: 當曉福在田裡捕魚時，他的母親正在準備出門。
ja: 曉福が田んぼで魚を釣っている間、彼の母親は街に出かける準備をしています。
local: While Xiaofu fishes out in the paddies, his mother gets preparing to hit the town.
ja_pron: Xiaofu ga tanbo de sakana o tsutte iru aida, kare no hahaoya wa machi ni dekakeru junbi o shiteimasu.
native: While Xiaofu fishes out in the paddies, his mother gets preparing to hit the town.

en: Buying everything else for the New Year's Eve meal is a job for mum.
zh: 買除夕晚餐的其他所有東西是媽媽的工作。
ja: 大晦日の食事のためのその他すべての買い物は母親の仕事です。
local: Buying everything else for the New Year's Eve meal is a job for mum.
ja_pron: Ōmisoka no shokuji no tame no sonota subete no kaimono wa hahaoya no shigoto desu.
native: Buying everything else for the New Year's Eve meal is a job for mum.

en: The male people have been farmers forever.
zh: 男性一直是農民。
ja: 男性はずっと農民でした。
local: The male people have been farmers forever.
ja_pron: Dansei wa zutto nōmin deshita.
native: The male people have been farmers forever.

en: As early as 6,000 years ago, they mastered the use of a special ingredient, the chilly
zh: 早在六千年前，他們就掌握了一種特殊成分的使用，辣椒
ja: 6000年前には、彼らは特別な材料、唐辛子の使い方を習得していました。
local: As early as 6,000 years ago, they mastered the use of a special ingredient, the chilly
ja_pron: 6000 nen mae ni wa, karera wa tokubetsu na zairyō, tōgarashi no tsukaikata o shūtoku shiteimashita.
native: As early as 6,000 years ago, they mastered the use of a special ingredient, the chilly

en: weekend, absolutely everything has been doused in them.
zh: 週末，所有東西都被辣椒淋上。
ja: 週末には、すべてのものが唐辛子で覆われています。
local: weekend, absolutely everything has been doused in them.
ja_pron: Shūmatsu ni wa, subete no mono ga tōgarashi de ōwareteimasu.
native: weekend, absolutely everything has been doused in them.

en: The light snow season sees the temperature drop sharply.
zh: 輕雪季節氣溫急劇下降。
ja: 軽い雪の季節には気温が急激に下がります。
local: The light snow season sees the temperature drop sharply.
ja_pron: Karui yuki no kisetsu ni wa kion ga kyūgeki ni sagarimasu.
native: The light snow season sees the temperature drop sharply.

en: The air turns crisp and dry.
zh: 空氣變得清新乾燥。
ja: 空気はさわやかで乾燥します。
local: The air turns crisp and dry.
ja_pron: Kūki wa sawayaka de kansō shimasu.
native: The air turns crisp and dry.

en: In the Chinese countryside, people wait for the light snow season to force starting to make
zh: 在中國鄉村，人們等待輕雪季節開始製作
ja: 中国の田舎では、人々は軽い雪の季節が始まるのを待って、
local: In the Chinese countryside, people wait for the light snow season to force starting to make
ja_pron: Chūgoku no inaka de wa, hitobito wa karui yuki no kisetsu ga hajimaru no o matte,
native: In the Chinese countryside, people wait for the light snow season to force starting to make

en: homemade sausages and smoke bacon.
zh: 自製香腸和煙燻培根。
ja: 自家製ソーセージやベーコンの燻製を始めます。
local: homemade sausages and smoke bacon.
ja_pron: Jikasei sōsēji ya bēkon no kunsei o hajimemasu.
native: homemade sausages and smoke bacon.

en: Pork dunked in sauteed pepper and salt, marinated for half a month.
zh: 豬肉浸泡在炒過的胡椒和鹽中，醃製半個月。
ja: 豚肉を炒めた胡椒と塩に浸し、半月間漬け込みます。
local: Pork dunked in sauteed pepper and salt, marinated for half a month.
ja_pron: Butaniku o itameta koshō to shio ni hitashi, hangetsukan tsukekomimasu.
native: Pork dunked in sauteed pepper and salt, marinated for half a month.

en: Hung from the beans, smoked from underneath by cypress twigs.
zh: 掛在豆莢上，下面用柏樹枝煙燻。
ja: 豆のさやから吊るされ、下からヒノキの小枝で燻製されます。
local: Hung from the beans, smoked from underneath by cypress twigs.
ja_pron: Mame no saya kara tsurasare, shita kara hinoki no koeda de kunsei saremasu.
native: Hung from the beans, smoked from underneath by cypress twigs.

en: You have to make sure that the smoke is evenly spread.
zh: 你必須確保煙霧均勻分布。
ja: 煙が均等に広がっていることを確認しなければなりません。
local: You have to make sure that the smoke is evenly spread.
ja_pron: Kemuri ga kintō ni hirogatte iru koto o kakunin shinakereba narimasen.
native: You have to make sure that the smoke is evenly spread.

en: The goal is for it to go dark red, then you know the flavour will have really sunk in.
zh: 目標是讓它變成深紅色，這樣你就知道味道真的滲透進去了。
ja: 目標は濃い赤色になることで、そうすれば味がしっかり染み込んでいることがわかります。
local: The goal is for it to go dark red, then you know the flavour will have really sunk in.
ja_pron: Mokuhyō wa koi akairo ni naru koto de, sō sureba aji ga shikkari shimikonde iru koto ga wakarimasu.
native: The goal is for it to go dark red, then you know the flavour will have really sunk in.

en: Chinese people have always smoked meat to preserve it.
zh: 中國人一直用煙燻肉類來保存它。
ja: 中国人は肉を保存するためにいつも燻製してきました。
local: Chinese people have always smoked meat to preserve it.
ja_pron: Chūgokujin wa niku o hozon suru tame ni itsumo kunsei shite kimashita.
native: Chinese people have always smoked meat to preserve it.

en: More than 2,500 years ago, it's Confucius even accepted bacon for lessons.
zh: 2500多年前，孔子甚至接受培根作為課程的報酬。
ja: 2500年以上前、孔子は授業の対価としてベーコンを受け入れていました。
local: More than 2,500 years ago, it's Confucius even accepted bacon for lessons.
ja_pron: 2500 nen ijō mae, Kōshi wa jugyō no taika to shite bēkon o ukeireteimashita.
native: More than 2,500 years ago, it's Confucius even accepted bacon for lessons.

en: Send me 10 strips of smoked bacon and I will teach you, he said, so his students did
zh: 他說：給我10條煙燻培根，我會教你們，所以他的學生照做了
ja: 「燻製ベーコンを10枚送ってくれれば教えてやる」と彼は言い、生徒たちはそうしました。
local: Send me 10 strips of smoked bacon and I will teach you, he said, so his students did
ja_pron: "Kunsei bēkon o 10 mai okutte kurereba oshiete yaru" to kare wa ii, seito-tachi wa sō shimashita.
native: Send me 10 strips of smoked bacon and I will teach you, he said, so his students did

en: exactly that.
zh: 正是如此。
ja: まさにそうしました。
local: exactly that.
ja_pron: Masani sō shimashita.
native: exactly that.

en: It's the eve of the Miao's New Year, never mind those gurgling stomachs, making an offering
zh: 這是苗族新年的前夕，別管那些咕嚕咕嚕叫的肚子，先行祭祖
ja: これは苗族の新年前夜です。お腹の鳴る音は気にせず、まずは先祖に供え物をします。
local: It's the eve of the Miao's New Year, never mind those gurgling stomachs, making an offering
ja_pron: Kore wa Byōzoku no shinnen zen'ya desu. Onaka no naru oto wa ki ni sezu, mazu wa senzo ni sonaemono o shimasu.
native: It's the eve of the Miao's New Year, never mind those gurgling stomachs, making an offering

en: to the ancestors is on top of the list.
zh: 祭祖是首要事項。
ja: 先祖への供え物が最優先です。
local: to the ancestors is on top of the list.
ja_pron: Senzo e no sonaemono ga saiyūsen desu.
native: to the ancestors is on top of the list.

en: They thank the clan for their blessings, the good fortune that has helped them bring in
zh: 他們感謝族群的祝福，這份好運幫助他們帶來
ja: 彼らは一族の祝福に感謝し、その幸運が収穫をもたらすのを助けました。
local: They thank the clan for their blessings, the good fortune that has helped them bring in
ja_pron: Karera wa ichizoku no shukufuku ni kansha shi, sono kōun ga shūkaku o motarasu no o tasukemashita.
native: They thank the clan for their blessings, the good fortune that has helped them bring in

en: a decent harvest.
zh: 一個體面的收成。
ja: 立派な収穫を。
local: a decent harvest.
ja_pron: Rippa na shūkaku o.
native: a decent harvest.

en: The New Year's Eve is a feast for the family and tomorrow's Miao Festival is
zh: 除夕是家庭的盛宴，明天的苗族節是
ja: 大晦日は家族の宴であり、明日の苗族祭りは
local: The New Year's Eve is a feast for the family and tomorrow's Miao Festival is
ja_pron: Ōmisoka wa kazoku no utage de ari, ashita no Byōzoku matsuri wa
native: The New Year's Eve is a feast for the family and tomorrow's Miao Festival is

en: a coming together of the whole clan.
zh: 整個族群的聚會。
ja: 一族全体の集まりです。
local: a coming together of the whole clan.
ja_pron: Ichizoku zentai no atsumari desu.
native: a coming together of the whole clan.

en: The relation and character in Guido province is one of the main settlements of the Miao
zh: 貴州省的關係和特性是苗族的主要聚居地之一
ja: 貴州省の関係と特徴は苗族の主要な居住地の一つです。
local: The relation and character in Guido province is one of the main settlements of the Miao
ja_pron: Guizhou-shō no kankei to tokuchō wa Byōzoku no shuyō na kyojūchi no hitotsu desu.
native: The relation and character in Guido province is one of the main settlements of the Miao

en: people.
zh: 人民。
ja: 人々です。
local: people.
ja_pron: Hitobito desu.
native: people.

en: Traditions at New Year have been passed down for thousands of years, strange and magnificent.
zh: 新年的傳統已經流傳了數千年，既奇特又壯麗。
ja: 新年の伝統は何千年も受け継がれており、不思議で壮大です。
local: Traditions at New Year have been passed down for thousands of years, strange and magnificent.
ja_pron: Shinnen no dentō wa nanzen-nen mo uketsugarete ori, fushigi de sōdai desu.
native: Traditions at New Year have been passed down for thousands of years, strange and magnificent.

en: Beautiful girls wearing silver horns are filling the square, attracting everyone's attention.
zh: 戴著銀角的美麗女孩充滿廣場，吸引著所有人的注意。
ja: 銀の角をつけた美しい少女たちが広場を埋め、皆の注目を集めています。
local: Beautiful girls wearing silver horns are filling the square, attracting everyone's attention.
ja_pron: Gin no tsuno o tsuketa utsukushii shōjo-tachi ga hiroba o ume, mina no chūmoku o atsumeteimasu.
native: Beautiful girls wearing silver horns are filling the square, attracting everyone's attention.

en: Other ornaments are 100% essential for the new year.
zh: 其他飾品對新年來說是百分之百必需的。
ja: 他の装飾品も新年には欠かせません。
local: Other ornaments are 100% essential for the new year.
ja_pron: Hoka no sōshokuhin mo shinnen ni wa kakasemasen.
native: Other ornaments are 100% essential for the new year.

en: A Miao girl here can wear anything from 10 to 15 kg of silver.
zh: 這裡的苗族女孩可以佩戴10到15公斤的銀飾。
ja: ここにいる苗族の少女は10から15キロの銀を身に着けることができます。
local: A Miao girl here can wear anything from 10 to 15 kg of silver.
ja_pron: Koko ni iru Byōzoku no shōjo wa 10 kara 15 kiro no gin o mi ni tsukeru koto ga dekimasu.
native: A Miao girl here can wear anything from 10 to 15 kg of silver.

en: The way they see it, if a girl does not have a set of silver jewelry, she can't even
zh: 他們認為，如果女孩沒有一套銀飾，她甚至不能
ja: 彼らの考えでは、少女が銀の装飾品を持っていなければ、結婚すら考えられません。
local: The way they see it, if a girl does not have a set of silver jewelry, she can't even
ja_pron: Karera no kangae de wa, shōjo ga gin no sōshokuhin o motte inakereba, kekkon sura kangaeraremasen.
native: The way they see it, if a girl does not have a set of silver jewelry, she can't even

en: consider getting married.
zh: 考慮結婚。
ja: 結婚を考えることもできません。
local: consider getting married.
ja_pron: Kekkon o kangaeru koto mo dekimasen.
native: consider getting married.

en: If a young man doesn't know how to craft silver, he has no way to make it in Leshan.
zh: 如果年輕人不知道如何製作銀飾，他在樂山就無法成功。
ja: 若い男性が銀細工の技術を知らなければ、楽山で成功する方法はありません。
local: If a young man doesn't know how to craft silver, he has no way to make it in Leshan.
ja_pron: Wakai dansei ga ginzaiku no gijutsu o shiranakereba, Rakuzan de seikō suru hōhō wa arimasen.
native: If a young man doesn't know how to craft silver, he has no way to make it in Leshan.

en: The locals tell me these extremely delicate patterns are all handcrafted by Miao Silversmiths.
zh: 當地人告訴我，這些極其精緻的圖案都是苗族銀匠手工製作的。
ja: 地元の人々は、これらの非常に繊細な模様はすべて苗族の銀細工職人による手作りだと教えてくれました。
local: The locals tell me these extremely delicate patterns are all handcrafted by Miao Silversmiths.
ja_pron: Jimoto no hitobito wa, korera no hijō ni sensai na moyō wa subete Byōzoku no ginzaiku shokunin ni yoru tedukuri da to oshiete kuremashita.
native: The locals tell me these extremely delicate patterns are all handcrafted by Miao Silversmiths.

en: Siao whose father Long Thayo is a Miao Silversmith.
zh: 曉福的父親龍泰耀是苗族銀匠。
ja: 曉福の父、龍泰耀は苗族の銀細工職人です。
local: Siao whose father Long Thayo is a Miao Silversmith.
ja_pron: Xiaofu no chichi Ryū Taiyō wa Byōzoku no ginzaiku shokunin desu.
native: Siao whose father Long Thayo is a Miao Silversmith.

en: Every year, during the light snow season, Miao farmers have little to do, but for Long
zh: 每年輕雪季節，苗族農民幾乎沒事可做，但對龍泰耀來說，
ja: 毎年、軽い雪の季節には苗族の農民はあまりすることがありませんが、龍泰耀にとっては、
local: Every year, during the light snow season, Miao farmers have little to do, but for Long
ja_pron: Maitoshi, karui yuki no kisetsu ni wa Byōzoku no nōmin wa amari suru koto ga arimasen ga, Ryū Taiyō ni totte wa,
native: Every year, during the light snow season, Miao farmers have little to do, but for Long

en: Thayo, this is absolutely the busiest time of year.
zh: 對龍泰耀來說，這絕對是一年中最忙的時候。
ja: 龍泰耀にとっては、これは間違いなく一年で最も忙しい時期です。
local: Thayo, this is absolutely the busiest time of year.
ja_pron: Ryū Taiyō ni totte wa, kore wa machigainaku ichinen de mottomo isogashii jiki desu.
native: Thayo, this is absolutely the busiest time of year.

en: People around the village rush to buy or repair their silver before getting decked out
zh: 村子裡的人們趕著購買或修理他們的銀飾，準備打扮一番
ja: 村の人々は新年の装いを整える前に銀製品を買ったり修理したりと急いでいます
local: People around the village rush to buy or repair their silver before getting decked out
native: People around the village rush to buy or repair their silver before getting decked out

en: for the new year.
zh: 為了新年。
ja: 新年のために。
local: for the new year.
native: for the new year.

en: Making Quiligri is what Long Thayo does best.
zh: 製作銀絲是龍泰優最擅長的。
ja: ロン・タイヨウが最も得意とするのはキリグリの製作です。
local: Making Quiligri is what Long Thayo does best.
native: Making Quiligri is what Long Thayo does best.

en: It's one of the most basic steps, but also one of the hardest.
zh: 這是最基本的步驟之一，但也是最困難的。
ja: これは最も基本的な工程の一つですが、同時に最も難しいものでもあります。
local: It's one of the most basic steps, but also one of the hardest.
native: It's one of the most basic steps, but also one of the hardest.

en: He has to turn bars of silver into silver string as fine as hair.
zh: 他必須將銀條拉成像頭髮般細的銀絲。
ja: 彼は銀の棒を髪の毛のように細い銀の糸に変えなければなりません。
local: He has to turn bars of silver into silver string as fine as hair.
native: He has to turn bars of silver into silver string as fine as hair.

en: This special silver drawing plate, 52 eyes of different diameters.
zh: 這個特殊的銀絲拉板，有52個不同直徑的孔眼。
ja: この特別な銀の引き板には、直径の異なる52の穴があります。
local: This special silver drawing plate, 52 eyes of different diameters.
native: This special silver drawing plate, 52 eyes of different diameters.

en: The silver strip must pass through all 52 in turn until it finally equals the diameter
zh: 銀絲必須依序穿過這52個孔，直到直徑等同於
ja: 銀の細長い帯は順番に52の穴すべてを通り抜け、最終的に直径が
local: The silver strip must pass through all 52 in turn until it finally equals the diameter
native: The silver strip must pass through all 52 in turn until it finally equals the diameter

en: of a human hair.
zh: 一根頭髮的直徑。
ja: 人間の髪の毛の太さになるまで細くします。
local: of a human hair.
native: of a human hair.

en: Filigri making is a very traditional Chinese craft.
zh: 銀絲製作是一項非常傳統的中國工藝。
ja: 銀細工の製作は非常に伝統的な中国の工芸です。
local: Filigri making is a very traditional Chinese craft.
native: Filigri making is a very traditional Chinese craft.

en: It's meticulous and needs a lot of patience.
zh: 這工藝非常細緻，需要大量耐心。
ja: それは細かくて忍耐力が必要です。
local: It's meticulous and needs a lot of patience.
native: It's meticulous and needs a lot of patience.

en: Found from silver as thin as silk thread.
zh: 用像絲線般細的銀絲製成。
ja: 絹糸のように細い銀から作られています。
local: Found from silver as thin as silk thread.
native: Found from silver as thin as silk thread.

en: It is welded into place and turned into the most exquisite pieces of drawing.
zh: 銀絲被焊接固定，變成最精緻的圖案。
ja: それは溶接されて固定され、最も精巧な細工品に仕上げられます。
local: It is welded into place and turned into the most exquisite pieces of drawing.
native: It is welded into place and turned into the most exquisite pieces of drawing.

en: Silver used to be China's hard currency.
zh: 銀曾是中國的硬通貨。
ja: 銀はかつて中国の硬貨でした。
local: Silver used to be China's hard currency.
native: Silver used to be China's hard currency.

en: In the maritime era, westerners used to buy Chinese goods with silver, like fine porcelain
zh: 在海洋時代，西方人用銀子購買中國商品，如精美瓷器
ja: 海洋時代には、西洋人は銀で中国の陶磁器などの品物を買っていました。
local: In the maritime era, westerners used to buy Chinese goods with silver, like fine porcelain
native: In the maritime era, westerners used to buy Chinese goods with silver, like fine porcelain

en: and silk and tea.
zh: 還有絲綢和茶葉。
ja: 絹やお茶もそうです。
local: and silk and tea.
native: and silk and tea.

en: Europeans would travel the world looking for silver producing colonies and most of this
zh: 歐洲人環遊世界尋找產銀殖民地，而大部分銀子
ja: ヨーロッパ人は銀を産出する植民地を求めて世界を旅し、その銀の多くは
local: Europeans would travel the world looking for silver producing colonies and most of this
native: Europeans would travel the world looking for silver producing colonies and most of this

en: silver would end up in China.
zh: 最終流入中國。
ja: 最終的に中国に流れ着きました。
local: silver would end up in China.
native: silver would end up in China.

en: Out of all the Chinese, the Miao might be the people who are the most in love with silver.
zh: 在所有中國人中，苗族可能是最熱愛銀飾的人。
ja: 中国の中でも、ミャオ族は銀を最も愛している人々かもしれません。
local: Out of all the Chinese, the Miao might be the people who are the most in love with silver.
native: Out of all the Chinese, the Miao might be the people who are the most in love with silver.

en: Their attraction to it goes way beyond its space value, as a cultural tradition that has
zh: 他們對銀的熱愛遠超過其物質價值，是一種流傳千年的文化傳統。
ja: 彼らの銀への魅力は単なる価値を超え、何千年も受け継がれてきた文化的伝統です。
local: Their attraction to it goes way beyond its space value, as a cultural tradition that has
native: Their attraction to it goes way beyond its space value, as a cultural tradition that has

en: been passed down for thousands of years.
zh: 這種傳統已經傳承了數千年。
ja: 何千年も受け継がれてきました。
local: been passed down for thousands of years.
native: been passed down for thousands of years.

en: This meant to bring luck and future good fortune.
zh: 這象徵帶來幸運和未來的好運。
ja: これは幸運と将来の繁栄をもたらす意味があります。
local: This meant to bring luck and future good fortune.
native: This meant to bring luck and future good fortune.

en: Here's an ocean of silver here.
zh: 這裡是一片銀海。
ja: ここには銀の海があります。
local: Here's an ocean of silver here.
native: Here's an ocean of silver here.

en: This is the annual festival of the Miao people, the end of the old year, but most importantly
zh: 這是苗族的年度節慶，舊年的結束，但最重要的是
ja: これはミャオ族の年に一度の祭りで、旧年の終わりですが、最も重要なのは
local: This is the annual festival of the Miao people, the end of the old year, but most importantly
native: This is the annual festival of the Miao people, the end of the old year, but most importantly

en: the start of a new year.
zh: 新年的開始。
ja: 新年の始まりです。
local: the start of a new year.
native: the start of a new year.

en: The Gumaas or the married daughters are back home with their families, for the most
zh: 已婚女兒（Gumaas）回家與家人團聚，參加最
ja: グマー（既婚の娘たち）が家族と共に帰省し、最も
local: The Gumaas or the married daughters are back home with their families, for the most
native: The Gumaas or the married daughters are back home with their families, for the most

en: traditional and lively event of the Miao year.
zh: 傳統且熱鬧的苗族年度盛事。
ja: 伝統的で賑やかなミャオ族の年中行事に参加します。
local: traditional and lively event of the Miao year.
native: traditional and lively event of the Miao year.

en: To be a Guma, you've got to be married.
zh: 成為Guma必須已婚。
ja: グマーになるには結婚していなければなりません。
local: To be a Guma, you've got to be married.
native: To be a Guma, you've got to be married.

en: In the headwear, a Miao woman is wearing, you can tell if she's single or not.
zh: 從苗族女性戴的頭飾可以看出她是否單身。
ja: ミャオ族の女性が身につける頭飾で、独身かどうかがわかります。
local: In the headwear, a Miao woman is wearing, you can tell if she's single or not.
native: In the headwear, a Miao woman is wearing, you can tell if she's single or not.

en: These girls with the silver horns on their heads are not married.
zh: 頭戴銀角的女孩是未婚的。
ja: 頭に銀の角をつけている女の子たちは未婚です。
local: These girls with the silver horns on their heads are not married.
native: These girls with the silver horns on their heads are not married.

en: Those without horns are the clan's married Gumaas.
zh: 沒有銀角的是家族中已婚的Guma。
ja: 角がないのは一族の既婚グマーです。
local: Those without horns are the clan's married Gumaas.
native: Those without horns are the clan's married Gumaas.

en: It used to be harder to travel, daughters who married far away could only meet up with
zh: 過去旅行較困難，遠嫁的女兒一年只能見母家一次。
ja: 昔は移動が難しく、遠くに嫁いだ娘は母方の家族に年に一度しか会えませんでした。
local: It used to be harder to travel, daughters who married far away could only meet up with
native: It used to be harder to travel, daughters who married far away could only meet up with

en: their mother's family once a year.
zh: 一年只能見母家一次。
ja: 母方の家族に年に一度だけ会えました。
local: their mother's family once a year.
native: their mother's family once a year.

en: This may have changed a lot, but this tradition has turned into a big event.
zh: 雖然現在改變很多，但這傳統已成為盛大活動。
ja: 今は大きく変わったかもしれませんが、この伝統は大きな行事になっています。
local: This may have changed a lot, but this tradition has turned into a big event.
native: This may have changed a lot, but this tradition has turned into a big event.

en: At this time every year, thousands of Gumaas meet in the county square.
zh: 每年此時，數千名Guma會聚集在縣廣場。
ja: 毎年この時期に、何千ものグマーが県の広場に集まります。
local: At this time every year, thousands of Gumaas meet in the county square.
native: At this time every year, thousands of Gumaas meet in the county square.

en: They bring with them chicken, ducks and fish, plus gifts such as newly harvested rice
zh: 他們帶來雞、鴨、魚和新收割的米等禮物
ja: 彼女たちは鶏、アヒル、魚、そして新しく収穫した米などの贈り物を持ってきます。
local: They bring with them chicken, ducks and fish, plus gifts such as newly harvested rice
native: They bring with them chicken, ducks and fish, plus gifts such as newly harvested rice

en: and walk home together for New Year.
zh: 一起走回家過新年。
ja: そして一緒に新年のために家に帰ります。
local: and walk home together for New Year.
native: and walk home together for New Year.

en: People are saying that the Gumaas who lives the furthest away has to carry this much
zh: 人們說住得最遠的Guma要背負這麼重的東西
ja: 最も遠くに住むグマーはこれほどの重さを運ばなければならないと言われています。
local: People are saying that the Gumaas who lives the furthest away has to carry this much
native: People are saying that the Gumaas who lives the furthest away has to carry this much

en: weight for as far as 10 kilometers.
zh: 長達10公里。
ja: 10キロメートルもの距離をです。
local: weight for as far as 10 kilometers.
native: weight for as far as 10 kilometers.

en: While Gumaas are carrying gifts for their families, their husbands have to keep up the
zh: 當Guma們背著禮物時，她們的丈夫必須維持
ja: グマーが家族への贈り物を運んでいる間、夫たちは
local: While Gumaas are carrying gifts for their families, their husbands have to keep up the
native: While Gumaas are carrying gifts for their families, their husbands have to keep up the

en: temple, playing their read pipes, the length of the street.
zh: 廟宇，沿街吹奏他們的笛子。
ja: 寺院を守り、通りの長さにわたって笛を吹き続けなければなりません。
local: temple, playing their read pipes, the length of the street.
native: temple, playing their read pipes, the length of the street.

en: This festival is in the hands of the women.
zh: 這個節慶由女性主導。
ja: この祭りは女性たちの手によって行われます。
local: This festival is in the hands of the women.
native: This festival is in the hands of the women.
